# SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers

SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers 2.5.1 (based on SQLite 3.53.4) by Ulrich Telle,
https://github.com/utelle/SQLite3MultipleCiphers, MIT License (`LICENSE`).
The amalgamation (`sqlite3mc_amalgamation-*.zip` of the v2.5.1 release,
SHA-256 4125f8ff275ea953dabb3289331b20a0e76d4fc060f57148f4a5df3bf3b0d5e0)
unmodified. It is SQLite (public domain) with page encryption added; TEKITO
uses it in place of the plain SQLite amalgamation, so the user's database can
be encrypted when the user turns that on.
